summary: A little bunny tells his mother all the imaginary ways he will run away from home. His mother tenderly explains how she will always find and care for him no matter where he goes.

chunks.target_answer_concept: The mother bunny will run after her little bunny.
acceptable_phrasings: His mom will chase after the bunny.
